exact_statement: For every balanced Boolean b, integers t,k>=1, q=2^-k and c=1/ln2, F=1+A_k(product_{j=1}^t b_j-1) has H(F)=q[tH(b)+4k+2c]-q^2(2k+3c)+R(q), I(F)=q[tI(b)+k], where R(q)=+4c sum_{j>=3}q^j/[j(j-1)(j-2)] and 0<R(q)<=2cq^3/[3(1-q)]. Therefore [tH(b)+4k+2c-q(2k+3c)]/[tI(b)+k] <= H(F)/I(F) <= that lower bound +2cq^2/[3(1-q)(tI(b)+k)]. The exact entropy is q t H(b)+(4q-2q^2)k-2(1-q)^2 log2(1-q); variance is 2q-q^2 and minority probability q/2. If k=o(t) and 2^-k t->0 for a fixed seed, H(F)/I(F)->H(b)/I(b) with influence tending to zero. The entropy control decrement remainder G_s=R(u)-R(2u)/2 at u=2^-s, s>=2, is negative and bounded below by -8cu^3/[3(1-2u)].
hypotheses: Boolean sign seed with mean zero
disjoint independent seed copies and fresh point controls
refutes: A021 stage-1 positive decrement remainder G_s

exact_statement: Let b=z times the selector between the four-bit quadratic bent sign and its value flip at zero. For every t,k>=1, g_t is its disjoint t-fold tensor, q=2^-k and F=1+A_k(g_t-1). For strict badness B_i>4 Inf_i, the complete control-first order controls/selectors/bent-data/balancing-signs has Q_bad=qt/4, and the complete data-first order selectors/bent-data/balancing-signs/controls has Q_bad=qt(k+4)/16. In both orders exactly selector nodes are bad. I(F)=q(53t/16+k), so the first ratio is <=4/53 while the second diverges for t=k^2. Any adaptive selector/control-only prefix, followed by bent-data/balancing-signs/remaining-controls, has exact Q_bad=q[4t+sum_j E r_j]/16, where r_j counts unqueried controls at its j-th selector on the hypothetical all-active control branch and expectation uses fair selector histories. More generally, for every finite K,Kprime>=0 there exist balanced tensor point-activations and a complete selector-first data tree with Q_bad,K>Kprime I(F): take an even fixed m>=4 with m-2>K, the balanced bent_m/zero-flip splice seed of influence i_m=1+m/2+(m+1)2^-m, and t=k^2. Its charge ratio is at least t2^-m(m+k)/(ti_m+k), which diverges. This refutes every-tree payment, not existential selection or stopping with paid terminal entropy.
hypotheses: fresh independent point controls and seed blocks
specified complete query orders and specified adaptive prefix class
refutes: There exist finite fixed K,Kprime such that EVERY complete physical restriction tree of EVERY Boolean function has Q_bad,K<=Kprime I.
